criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.identifiers.NormalizeIdentifiers(fields=("doi", "isbn"), strict=False) as an opt-in non-mutating BlockMiddleware. Canonicalize DOI URL/doi prefixes and case without stripping potentially valid punctuation, normalize ISBN10/13 whitespace/hyphens and verify check digits including X. Preserve original values/status in metadata; invalid values remain unchanged unless strict requests failure. Only selected fields change, no external lookup or guessed repairs, and normal parsing/writing remains compatible.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
